name: DC-DC Converters and Line Frequency Rectifiers
description: Steady-state operating principles of switching converters, synthesis of buck, boost, and derived converters, steady-state modelling of DC-DC converters, switch realization, determination of conduction and switching losses, continuous and discontinuous conduction mode operation, small signal modeling, controller design. Analysis of isolated converters- flyback, forward, etc. Passive elements design – capacitor selection and calculations, inductor and transformer design. Thermal modelling and design. Single-phase and three-phase controlled and uncontrolled rectifiers with R, RL, and RC loads, effect of input inductance, challenges with harmonics, total harmonic distortion.
